notes:
Lead source: inbound self-serve signup (trial credit used). Founder + Head of Product engaged. SMB (direct-to-consumer e-comm marketplace). Wants lightweight hosted option with predictable pricing and easy model swaps.

Quick summary / ask: evaluate model tradeoffs Llama/Mistral/Qwen variants for multi-turn customer chat + nightly semantic search embeddings. Emphasis on cost control but cannot sacrifice intent-classification quality. Asked for guidance on 7B vs 13B (latency/cost/quality) and quantized variants.

Requirements (from call):
- Workloads: interactive chat (customer support bots) + embedding-based product search + short-form recommendation text. Low context lengths (<=512 tokens typical).
- Latency target: p90 <= 350ms for short chat turns (frontend experience). Can tolerate occasional fallbacks to higher-latency model for complex queries.
- Throughput: ~10-25 rps average, burst to 80 rps during peak sales.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget conscious; wants cost per 1M tokens estimate across model families.
- Model preferences: open to Mistral 7B / Llama2-13B / Qwen-7B as primary candidates. Interested in Redwood-recommended default + a low-cost fallback (quantized 4-bit) and a higher-quality variant for escalation.
- Security: Okta SSO for admin portal required, basic audit logs needed. Data residency not strict but asked about EU region availability.

Timeline & recent activity (shorthand):
- 2026-02-18: self-serve signup, trial credits used, initial logs show embedding and chat API calls.
- 2026-03-03: discovery call (Fireflies id ff_20260303_taproot_demo). AE intro + SE technical Q&A. SE requested perf matrix.
- 2026-03-05: SE sent sample prompt set and eval checklist (drive:/decks/taproot-redwood-pricing-v1.pdf).
- 2026-03-08: internal engineering follow-up; asked for latency numbers on Mistral 7B vs Llama2 13B w/ Redwood hosted.
- 2026-03-09: demo of Hosted API streaming + retry/fallback behavior. Notes: liked streaming, asked about tokenization differences between models.

What we recommended on call:
- Start with Mistral 7B for chat baseline (good quality/cost for casual support dialogs).
- Use Llama2-13B only for high-confidence escalation paths (intent classification / complex summarization).
- For embeddings: use a small dedicated model (cheap dense embedder) and run nightly reindexing; batching to reduce cost.
- Provide a cost/latency matrix showing per-1M-token cost across: Mistral-7B (fp16), Mistral-7B-4bit (quant), Llama2-13B (fp16), Qwen-7B, and Redwood-managed caching options.

Quotes / call snippets: "We need a clear playbook — when do we use the cheap model vs the expensive one?"; "If we can get p90 under 350ms with Mistral 7B we're happy to trade some edge-case quality for big cost savings."

- Clarify burst pricing and token rate limits for self-serve tenants.
- Confirm Okta SSO integration steps for AE to share with ops.

Next steps (short):
